def extract_exif_metadata(image_path):
    """Extract all available EXIF metadata from image"""
    print(f"   📋 Extracting EXIF metadata...")
    metadata = {
        "file_path": str(image_path),
        "file_name": image_path.name,
        "file_size_bytes": image_path.stat().st_size,
        "file_modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(image_path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(),
    }
    
    try:
        img = Image.open(image_path)
        metadata["image_format"] = img.format
        metadata["image_mode"] = img.mode
        metadata["image_width"] = img.width
        metadata["image_height"] = img.height
        
        # Extract EXIF data
        exif_data = img._getexif()
        if exif_data:
            exif_dict = {}
            gps_info = {}
            
            for tag_id, value in exif_data.items():
                tag_name = TAGS.get(tag_id, str(tag_id))
                
                # Handle GPS info specially
                if tag_name == "GPSInfo":
                    for gps_tag_id, gps_value in value.items():
                        gps_tag_name = GPSTAGS.get(gps_tag_id, str(gps_tag_id))
                        # Convert to serializable format
                        if hasattr(gps_value, '__iter__') and not isinstance(gps_value, (str, bytes)):
                            gps_value = [float(v) if hasattr(v, 'numerator') else v for v in gps_value]
                        gps_info[gps_tag_name] = str(gps_value)
                    metadata["gps_info"] = gps_info
                else:
                    # Convert to serializable format
                    if isinstance(value, bytes):
                        try:
                            value = value.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                        except:
                            value = str(value)
                    elif hasattr(value, 'numerator'):  # Rational number
                        value = float(value)
                    exif_dict[tag_name] = str(value)
            
            metadata["exif"] = exif_dict
            
            # Extract specific useful fields
            if "DateTimeOriginal" in exif_dict:
                metadata["date_taken"] = exif_dict["DateTimeOriginal"]
            if "Make" in exif_dict:
                metadata["camera_make"] = exif_dict["Make"]
            if "Model" in exif_dict:
                metadata["camera_model"] = exif_dict["Model"]
            if "ExposureTime" in exif_dict:
                metadata["exposure_time"] = exif_dict["ExposureTime"]
            if "FNumber" in exif_dict:
                metadata["f_number"] = exif_dict["FNumber"]
            if "ISOSpeedRatings" in exif_dict:
                metadata["iso"] = exif_dict["ISOSpeedRatings"]
            
            # Parse GPS coordinates if available
            if gps_info:
                try:
                    lat = gps_info.get("GPSLatitude")
                    lat_ref = gps_info.get("GPSLatitudeRef", "N")
                    lon = gps_info.get("GPSLongitude")
                    lon_ref = gps_info.get("GPSLongitudeRef", "E")
                    if lat and lon:
                        metadata["gps_coordinates"] = {
                            "latitude": lat,
                            "latitude_ref": lat_ref,
                            "longitude": lon,
                            "longitude_ref": lon_ref
                        }
                except:
                    pass
        
        img.close()
        print(f"      Found {len(metadata.get('exif', {}))} EXIF fields")
        
    except Exception as e:
        metadata["exif_error"] = str(e)
        print(f"      ⚠️ EXIF extraction error: {e}")
    
    return metadata


def detect_objects(image, threshold=0.7):
    """Run object detection using DETR model"""
    print(f"   🔍 Running object detection...")
    
    inputs = detr_processor(images=image, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = detr_model(**inputs)
    
    # Get predictions
    target_sizes = torch.tensor([image.size[::-1]]).to(device)
    results = detr_processor.post_process_object_detection(outputs, target_sizes=target_sizes, threshold=threshold)[0]
    
    detected_objects = []
    for score, label, box in zip(results["scores"], results["labels"], results["boxes"]):
        label_name = detr_model.config.id2label[label.item()]
        detected_objects.append({
            "label": label_name,
            "confidence": round(score.item(), 3),
            "bounding_box": [round(x, 2) for x in box.tolist()]
        })
    
    print(f"      Found {len(detected_objects)} objects")
    return detected_objects


def get_clip_embeddings_and_tags(image, tags=ZERO_SHOT_TAGS, top_k=15):
    """Get CLIP embeddings and zero-shot classification tags"""
    print(f"   🏷️ Running CLIP zero-shot tagging...")
    
    # Get image embedding
    image_inputs = clip_processor(images=image, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        image_features = clip_model.get_image_features(**image_inputs)
    
    # Normalize
    image_embedding = image_features / image_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    
    # Get text embeddings for tags
    text_inputs = clip_processor(text=tags, return_tensors="pt", padding=True).to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        text_features = clip_model.get_text_features(**text_inputs)
    text_features = text_features / text_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    
    # Compute similarities
    similarities = (image_embedding @ text_features.T).squeeze(0)
    
    # Get top tags
    values, indices = similarities.topk(min(top_k, len(tags)))
    
    top_tags = []
    for val, idx in zip(values.tolist(), indices.tolist()):
        top_tags.append({
            "tag": tags[idx],
            "confidence": round(val, 3)
        })
    
    print(f"      Top tags: {[t['tag'] for t in top_tags[:5]]}")
    
    return {
        "embedding": image_embedding.cpu().numpy().tolist()[0],
        "zero_shot_tags": top_tags
    }


def generate_caption(image):
    """Generate natural language caption using BLIP"""
    print(f"   💬 Generating caption...")
    
    # Unconditional captioning
    inputs = blip_processor(image, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = blip_model.generate(**inputs, max_length=50, num_beams=5)
    caption = blip_processor.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
    
    # Conditional captioning with different prompts
    prompts = [
        "a photo of",
        "this image shows",
        "in this picture"
    ]
    
    captions = [caption]
    for prompt in prompts:
        inputs = blip_processor(image, prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = blip_model.generate(**inputs, max_length=50, num_beams=3)
        cond_caption = blip_processor.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
        if cond_caption not in captions:
            captions.append(cond_caption)
    
    print(f"      Caption: {caption}")
    
    # Derive tags from captions
    derived_tags = set()
    for cap in captions:
        words = cap.lower().replace(",", "").replace(".", "").split()
        # Filter to meaningful words (longer than 3 chars, not common words)
        common_words = {"the", "a", "an", "of", "in", "on", "at", "to", "for", "with", "and", "is", "are", "this", "that", "photo", "picture", "image", "shows", "showing"}
        for word in words:
            if len(word) > 3 and word not in common_words:
                derived_tags.add(word)
    
    return {
        "primary_caption": caption,
        "alternative_captions": captions[1:],
        "derived_tags": list(derived_tags)
    }


def extract_faces(image_path, image):

            face_encodings = face_recognition.face_encodings(img_array, face_locations)
            
            for i, (location, encoding) in enumerate(zip(face_locations, face_encodings)):
                top, right, bottom, left = location
                faces.append({
                    "face_id": i,
                    "bounding_box": {"top": top, "right": right, "bottom": bottom, "left": left},
                    "embedding": encoding.tolist()
                })
            
            print(f"      Found {len(faces)} faces")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"      ⚠️ Face detection error: {e}")
    else:
        # Fallback: detect persons from object detection and note them

    return faces


def get_image_files(directory):
    """Get all image files from directory"""
    image_extensions = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp', '.tiff', '.webp', '.heic', '.heif'}
    image_files = []
    
    for ext in image_extensions:
        image_files.extend(directory.glob(f'*{ext}'))
        image_files.extend(directory.glob(f'*{ext.upper()}'))
    
    return sorted(set(image_files))


def process_image(image_path):
    """Process a single image through all extraction methods"""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"📷 Processing: {image_path.name}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    result = {
        "file_name": image_path.name,
        "processed_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    }
    
    try:
        # Load image
        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        
        # 1. Extract metadata
        result["metadata"] = extract_exif_metadata(image_path)
        
        # 2. Object detection
        result["object_detection"] = detect_objects(image)
        
        # 3. CLIP embeddings and zero-shot tags
        clip_results = get_clip_embeddings_and_tags(image)
        result["clip_embedding"] = clip_results["embedding"]
        result["zero_shot_tags"] = clip_results["zero_shot_tags"]
        
        # 4. Captioning
        caption_results = generate_caption(image)
        result["captions"] = caption_results
        
        # 5. Face detection
        result["faces"] = extract_faces(image_path, image)
        
        # Compile all tags
        all_tags = set()
        
        # From object detection
        for obj in result["object_detection"]:
            all_tags.add(obj["label"])
        
        # From zero-shot tags (high confidence)
        for tag in result["zero_shot_tags"]:
            if tag["confidence"] > 0.2:
                all_tags.add(tag["tag"])
        
        # From caption-derived tags
        all_tags.update(result["captions"]["derived_tags"])
        
        result["consolidated_tags"] = sorted(list(all_tags))
        
        image.close()
        print(f"   ✅ Successfully processed {image_path.name}")
        
    except Exception as e:
        result["error"] = str(e)
        print(f"   ❌ Error processing {image_path.name}: {e}")
    
    return result


def cluster_faces(all_results):
    """Cluster similar faces across all images"""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"👥 Clustering faces across all images...")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Collect all face embeddings
    face_data = []
    for result in all_results:
        file_name = result["file_name"]
        for face in result.get("faces", []):
            if "embedding" in face:
                face_data.append({
                    "file_name": file_name,
                    "face_id": face["face_id"],
                    "embedding": face["embedding"],
                    "bounding_box": face.get("bounding_box")
                })
    
    if len(face_data) < 2:
        print(f"   Not enough faces for clustering ({len(face_data)} faces)")
        return {"total_faces": len(face_data), "clusters": [], "unclustered": face_data}
    
    # Extract embeddings matrix
    embeddings = np.array([f["embedding"] for f in face_data])
    
    # Use DBSCAN for clustering (doesn't require predefined number of clusters)
    clustering = DBSCAN(eps=0.6, min_samples=2, metric='euclidean').fit(embeddings)
    
    # Group faces by cluster
    clusters = {}
    unclustered = []
    
    for i, label in enumerate(clustering.labels_):
        face_info = {
            "file_name": face_data[i]["file_name"],
            "face_id": face_data[i]["face_id"],
            "bounding_box": face_data[i]["bounding_box"]
        }
        
        if label == -1:
            unclustered.append(face_info)
        else:
            cluster_key = f"person_{label}"
            if cluster_key not in clusters:
                clusters[cluster_key] = []
            clusters[cluster_key].append(face_info)
    
    print(f"   Found {len(clusters)} distinct people across {len(face_data)} faces")
    print(f"   {len(unclustered)} faces could not be clustered")
    
    return {
        "total_faces": len(face_data),
        "num_clusters": len(clusters),
        "clusters": clusters,
        "unclustered": unclustered
    }

        # Get image embedding

        text_features = text_features / text_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

def extract_exif_metadata(image_path):

        "file_modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(image_path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(),
    }
    
    try:
        img = Image.open(image_path)
        metadata["image_format"] = img.format
        metadata["image_mode"] = img.mode
        metadata["image_width"] = img.width
        metadata["image_height"] = img.height
        
        # Extract EXIF data
        exif_data = img._getexif()
        if exif_data:
            exif_dict = {}
            gps_info = {}
            
            for tag_id, value in exif_data.items():
                tag_name = TAGS.get(tag_id, str(tag_id))
                
                # Handle GPS info specially
                if tag_name == "GPSInfo":
                    for gps_tag_id, gps_value in value.items():
                        gps_tag_name = GPSTAGS.get(gps_tag_id, str(gps_tag_id))
                        # Convert to serializable format
                        if hasattr(gps_value, '__iter__') and not isinstance(gps_value, (str, bytes)):
                            gps_value = [float(v) if hasattr(v, 'numerator') else v for v in gps_value]
                        gps_info[gps_tag_name] = str(gps_value)
                    metadata["gps_info"] = gps_info
                else:
                    # Convert to serializable format
                    if isinstance(value, bytes):
                        try:
                            value = value.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                        except:
                            value = str(value)
                    elif hasattr(value, 'numerator'):  # Rational number
                        value = float(value)
                    exif_dict[tag_name] = str(value)
            
            metadata["exif"] = exif_dict
            
            # Extract specific useful fields

def get_clip_embeddings_and_tags(image, tags=ZERO_SHOT_TAGS, top_k=15):
    """Get CLIP embeddings and zero-shot classification tags"""
    print(f"   🏷️ Running CLIP zero-shot tagging...")
    
    # Get image embedding
    image_inputs = clip_processor(images=image, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        image_features = clip_model.get_image_features(**image_inputs)
    
    # Normalize
    image_embedding = image_features / image_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    
    # Get text embeddings for tags
    text_inputs = clip_processor(text=tags, return_tensors="pt", padding=True).to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        text_features = clip_model.get_text_features(**text_inputs)
    text_features = text_features / text_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    
    # Compute similarities
    similarities = (image_embedding @ text_features.T).squeeze(0)
    
    # Get top tags
    values, indices = similarities.topk(min(top_k, len(tags)))
    
    top_tags = []
    for val, idx in zip(values.tolist(), indices.tolist()):
        top_tags.append({
            "tag": tags[idx],
            "confidence": round(val, 3)
        })
    
    print(f"      Top tags: {[t['tag'] for t in top_tags[:5]]}")
    
    return {
        "embedding": image_embedding.cpu().numpy().tolist()[0],
        "zero_shot_tags": top_tags
    }


def generate_caption(image):
    """Generate natural language caption using BLIP"""
    print(f"   💬 Generating caption...")
    
    # Unconditional captioning
    inputs = blip_processor(image, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = blip_model.generate(**inputs, max_length=50, num_beams=5)
    caption = blip_processor.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
    
    # Conditional captioning with different prompts
    prompts = [
        "a photo of",
        "this image shows",
        "in this picture"
    ]
    
    captions = [caption]
    for prompt in prompts:
        inputs = blip_processor(image, prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = blip_model.generate(**inputs, max_length=50, num_beams=3)
        cond_caption = blip_processor.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
        if cond_caption not in captions:
            captions.append(cond_caption)
    
    print(f"      Caption: {caption}")
    
    # Derive tags from captions
    derived_tags = set()
    for cap in captions:
        words = cap.lower().replace(",", "").replace(".", "").split()
        # Filter to meaningful words (longer than 3 chars, not common words)
        common_words = {"the", "a", "an", "of", "in", "on", "at", "to", "for", "with", "and", "is", "are", "this", "that", "photo", "picture", "image", "shows", "showing"}
        for word in words:
            if len(word) > 3 and word not in common_words:
                derived_tags.add(word)
    
    return {
        "primary_caption": caption,
        "alternative_captions": captions[1:],
        "derived_tags": list(derived_tags)

def zero_shot_tagging(image: Image.Image, candidate_labels: list) -> list:
    """Use CLIP for zero-shot classification/tagging."""
    print(f"    🏷️ Running zero-shot tagging...")
    if not clip_available:
        return []
    
    try:
        inputs = clip_processor(text=candidate_labels, images=image, return_tensors="pt", padding=True)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = clip_model(**inputs)
        
        logits_per_image = outputs.logits_per_image
        probs = logits_per_image.softmax(dim=1)[0]
        
        tags = []
        for label, prob in zip(candidate_labels, probs):
            if prob.item() > 0.1:  # Only include if probability > 10%
                tags.append({

def extract_exif_metadata(image_path: Path) -> dict:
    """Extract EXIF metadata from an image file."""
    print(f"    📋 Extracting EXIF metadata...")
    metadata = {
        "date_taken": None,
        "camera_make": None,
        "camera_model": None,
        "gps_latitude": None,
        "gps_longitude": None,
        "exposure_time": None,
        "f_number": None,
        "iso": None,
        "focal_length": None,
        "orientation": None,
        "software": None,
        "raw_exif": {}
    }
    
    try:
        img = Image.open(image_path)
        exif_data = img._getexif()
        
        if exif_data:
            for tag_id, value in exif_data.items():
                tag = TAGS.get(tag_id, tag_id)
                
                # Convert bytes to string if needed
                if isinstance(value, bytes):
                    try:
                        value = value.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                    except:
                        value = str(value)
                
                # Store raw EXIF (convert non-serializable types)
                try:
                    json.dumps(value)
                    metadata["raw_exif"][tag] = value
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    metadata["raw_exif"][tag] = str(value)
                
                # Extract specific fields
                if tag == "DateTimeOriginal":
                    metadata["date_taken"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "Make":
                    metadata["camera_make"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "Model":
                    metadata["camera_model"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "ExposureTime":
                    metadata["exposure_time"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "FNumber":
                    metadata["f_number"] = float(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "ISOSpeedRatings":
                    metadata["iso"] = int(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "FocalLength":
                    metadata["focal_length"] = float(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "Orientation":
                    metadata["orientation"] = int(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "Software":
                    metadata["software"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "GPSInfo":
                    # Parse GPS data
                    gps_data = {}
                    for gps_tag_id, gps_value in value.items():
                        gps_tag = GPSTAGS.get(gps_tag_id, gps_tag_id)
                        gps_data[gps_tag] = gps_value
                    
                    # Convert GPS coordinates to decimal
                    if "GPSLatitude" in gps_data and "GPSLatitudeRef" in gps_data:
                        lat = gps_data["GPSLatitude"]
                        lat_ref = gps_data["GPSLatitudeRef"]
                        lat_decimal = float(lat[0]) + float(lat[1])/60 + float(lat[2])/3600
                        if lat_ref == "S":
                            lat_decimal = -lat_decimal
                        metadata["gps_latitude"] = lat_decimal
                    
                    if "GPSLongitude" in gps_data and "GPSLongitudeRef" in gps_data:
                        lon = gps_data["GPSLongitude"]
                        lon_ref = gps_data["GPSLongitudeRef"]
                        lon_decimal = float(lon[0]) + float(lon[1])/60 + float(lon[2])/3600
                        if lon_ref == "W":
                            lon_decimal = -lon_decimal
                        metadata["gps_longitude"] = lon_decimal
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"    ⚠️ Error extracting EXIF: {e}")
    
    return metadata

    }
    
    try:
        img = Image.open(image_path)
        exif_data = img._getexif()
        
        if exif_data:
            for tag_id, value in exif_data.items():
                tag = TAGS.get(tag_id, tag_id)
                
                # Convert bytes to string if needed
                if isinstance(value, bytes):
                    try:
                        value = value.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                    except:
                        value = str(value)
                
                # Store raw EXIF (convert non-serializable types)
                try:
                    json.dumps(value)
                    metadata["raw_exif"][tag] = value
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    metadata["raw_exif"][tag] = str(value)
                
                # Extract specific fields
                if tag == "DateTimeOriginal":
                    metadata["date_taken"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "Make":
                    metadata["camera_make"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "Model":
                    metadata["camera_model"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "ExposureTime":
                    metadata["exposure_time"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "FNumber":
                    metadata["f_number"] = float(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "ISOSpeedRatings":
                    metadata["iso"] = int(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "FocalLength":
                    metadata["focal_length"] = float(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "Orientation":
                    metadata["orientation"] = int(value) if value else None
                elif tag == "Software":
                    metadata["software"] = str(value)
                elif tag == "GPSInfo":
                    # Parse GPS data
                    gps_data = {}
                    for gps_tag_id, gps_value in value.items():
                        gps_tag = GPSTAGS.get(gps_tag_id, gps_tag_id)
                        gps_data[gps_tag] = gps_value
                    
                    # Convert GPS coordinates to decimal
                    if "GPSLatitude" in gps_data and "GPSLatitudeRef" in gps_data:
                        lat = gps_data["GPSLatitude"]
                        lat_ref = gps_data["GPSLatitudeRef"]
                        lat_decimal = float(lat[0]) + float(lat[1])/60 + float(lat[2])/3600
                        if lat_ref == "S":

                        metadata["gps_latitude"] = lat_decimal
                    
                    if "GPSLongitude" in gps_data and "GPSLongitudeRef" in gps_data:
